x: One of the best performances of the evening was by one of our new members, E. Pfenninger, who was placed third off scratch in the Shot Putt.
Fleming won the Police Championship Long Jump event at Glasgow with a splendid leap; and in E. Pfenninger we have a Shot Putter and all-round athlete of infinite promise.
Many of our older members will remember the father of the first-named, EMIL PFENNINGER, who in the 1930s was a great source of strength to our teams in the field events.
In the thirties Emil Pfenninger, a stocky built Swiss did the Jumps, Shot and Discus; he was also an International Gymnast and a Swiss Army Ski Instructor.
